description: This header file defines the interfaces for the Wraps class and its implementation, providing an abstraction layer over system calls and file operations for mocking and testing purposes.
external_methods: virtually all methods (system, popen, pclose, syslog, setmntent, getmntent, v_secure_popen, v_secure_pclose, v_secure_system, readlink, time) are declared as virtual in WrapsImpl and static or instance methods in Wraps

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract class defining virtual methods to wrap system-level functions, enabling mocking and dependency injection.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A class providing static access to system functions through an implementation point, following singleton pattern and supporting dependency injection.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance for wrapping system calls.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Wraps class.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Executes a system command through the underlying implementation.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, as defined in the implementation.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Reads a mount entry from the mount table.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Secure version of popen with additional arguments.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Secure version of system call with va_list args.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symbolic link.
